notes.title: ✨ Nosferatu Lilinor: SUMMER SALE 2024! ✨ [it's over]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36172186/b51e584808dc2a764776872b6d6956442bee222f.png[/img]

Hi there,
Calling all players on Steam!

Thanks for checking out Nosferatu Lilinor!

The Steam Summer Sale 2024 is here, and you can grab Dot Piece Puzzle at 30% off the regular price during the sale period.

Don't be fooled by its cute looks – Nosferatu Lilinor packs a challenge! Prepare for mind-bending puzzles and thrilling adventures as you guide the adorable vampire Lilinor through intricate dungeons.

[h3]Sale Period: 10:00 a.m. June 27th (Thu) to 9:59 a.m. July 11th (Thu) 2024 PDT[/h3]

[h3]Don't miss this chance to play Nosferatu Lilinor![/h3]

notes.title: 💓🎉Illustrations for the 2024 New Year's greetings🎉💓
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36172186/83f0484c45703ba12d80402ef42f28acea6c1b56.png[/img]

Sorry for the delay in greeting you, but happy new year 2024!

As an illustration for our New Year's greeting card,
[h3]madara([url=https://x.com/mbl_cod]@mbl_cod[/url]) drew a very cute illustration![/h3]
Thank you very much, madara!

We wish you all the best for 2024.
Please continue to enjoy "Nosferatu Lilinor".

Thank you,

notes.title: 'Nosferatu Lilinor' UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36172186/f8e17e122fbb224263838822ba3f5d70c3f1826a.png[/img]

Ver.1.0.10 update's details

-Added explanatory text to the difficulty selection screen and changed the layout.
-Adjusted death log performance.
-Fixed the behavior of some bosses.
-Fixed a bug that prevented the waiting motion of some character skins from occurring.
-Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: 'Nosferatu Lilinor' UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36172186/079f4c59c9b789c1c0e52d9d28ebc57c2ae5a320.png[/img]
Ver.1.0.9 update's details

-Now compatible with PlayStation 4 controller, PlayStation 5 controller, and Nintendo Switch Pro controller.
-When pressing the summon button with a diagonal input that contains an upper element, the summon will now be executed horizontally.
-Adjusted the event direction.
-Fixed minor bugs.
